name: team_planning_scenario_map
description: Get one scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, resolved: the baseline with the changes of every scenario it follows and its own. Units carry their parent, level and owners; an Org Graph unit's level_id is its type today, which a structure declared since the base may have changed, as the plan's checks read it. While the Org Graph's structure is being rebuilt, `unchecked` lists "unit_types" and each level_id is the one the plan holds, which can be its type on the base date; otherwise `unchecked` is empty. People carry their facts and each place they hold (a unit, or a position with its unit), with allocation and role, plus allocation_total: over 1 when over-allocated, null when unknown because the HRIS gave no allocation. unassigned_ids are the people in no live unit. Positions carry their occupants, open_fte and backfill_for_ids (whose departure each backfills). People carry their reporting line (manager_id, or manager_position_id for a manager being hired) and leaving, with leaves_on (null without a date) and backfill_position_id, when they leave in this scenario's step; departed lists those who left in an earlier step, with their backfill. unresolved lists people the plan places who aren't on the map, with why: 'joined after the base date' (team_planning_rebase_plan brings them in) or 'has left'. `names` maps every person id to a name; a forgotten person reads as "Former member". known_on is null when the Org Graph is read as it stands now. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
